title: Euroculture Erasmus Mundus Joint Master (2027–2029)
institution: Euroculture Erasmus Mundus Joint Master consortium

compensation.value: Erasmus Mundus scholarship: participation fees, health insurance and living costs of EUR 1,400 per month
compensation.evidence_quote: It covers participation fees for the Euroculture programme, health insurance, living costs (€1.400 per month)

about: Applications for the 2027-2029 Euroculture Erasmus Mundus Joint Master opened on 15 October 2026. To be considered for an Erasmus Mundus scholarship, a complete application must be submitted by 15 January 2027. The scholarship covers participation fees, health insurance and EUR 1,400 monthly living costs.
requirements: First higher education degree (or recognised equivalent) by the deadline; an official document confirming completion is sufficient
English test results must be in by 15 January 2027 for scholarship consideration
